text:
Maya: FYI customer asked us to grant a temporary 'infra-admin' role on their private site for debugging. Need controls.
Ashok: Must be time-limited (8h default, 24h max with sec approval) + Jira approval link.
Jordan: Important: scope KMS usage. No direct console/KMS creds. All key-use must be audited.
Maya: Confirmed. infra-admin can call internal service endpoints only; every call logged.
Ivan (ops): Ops checklist: RBAC TTL enforced by auth service, token includes approver/expiry, post-expiry reconciliation job.
Remy: SIEM: forward structured audit events and netflow. For air-gapped sites provide Fluentd sample.
Ashok: Proposed NetworkPolicy to limit control-plane egress to KMS proxy + metrics (example):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: cp-egress-kms-only
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: control-plane
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: onprem-kms-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
Jordan: Audit JSON schema to SIEM: actor, role_granted, approver, expiry, reason, request_id. Example: {"actor":"infra/sre-4","role":"infra-admin","approver":"sec-oncall","expiry":"2026-06-12T14:00:00Z","request_id":"INC-12345"}
Ivan (ops): To avoid persistence: automation revokes grants at expiry and scans for active sessions/tokens. Hourly reconcile.
Remy: For on-prem HSMs: rotate wrapping key (KEK) and revoke service principals; provide dry-run rotation.
Maya: Proposed workflow: require Jira approval, grant TTLed RBAC, emit structured audit event, apply conservative NetworkPolicy, run post-expiry reconciliation + short post-mortem.
sec-bot: Action created sec/2347 assigned Ashok ETA 3d.
Ashok: I'll open PR for TTL enforcement + audit webhook. Jordan: I'll add Fluentd sample and schema to docs.
Ivan (ops): If suspicious activity: revoke immediately, capture sessions, collect logs, open incident channel and escalate.
Maya: Thanks all, will link the Jira in the runbook once PR lands. :thumbsup:
